baseline_models.focus_anchor: The noun السماء names the overhead cover, while the inchoative انشقت makes that cover itself undergo opening.
baseline_models.mechanism: A continuous upper boundary loses integrity from within. The event therefore changes enclosure into access: what functioned as a ceiling no longer seals the world below it.

activation_trace.role: The overhead covering supplies the bounded upper surface whose continuity can fail.
Physical fissuring supplies the breach that converts a sealed cover into an opening.

changed_reading.before: The sky splits in a generic catastrophic event.
changed_reading.after: The world's overhead enclosure is breached, so the verse marks the loss of a formerly sealing boundary.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The raised visible outline named by السماء is acted on by a root that can produce halves and corresponding sides.
baseline_models.mechanism: The opening does not only destroy a surface; it articulates that surface into opposed but related flanks. Division can preserve a counterpart relation even while wholeness is lost.

activation_trace.role: The raised visible outline gives the sky a discernible form capable of being articulated into sides.
The image of halves and corresponding sides makes cleavage an ordered relation rather than undifferentiated ruin.

changed_reading.after: The raised whole separates into corresponding sides, introducing orientation and opposition inside the rupture.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: A non-dominant mapped inventory for السماء activates the visible mark, while انشقت supplies the line cut into the surface.
baseline_models.mechanism: The fissure changes the sky from background into marked surface. Its break is also an identifying trace: the event writes its occurrence onto the thing that undergoes it.

activation_trace.role: A visible identifying mark recasts the sky as a surface that can bear readable evidence.
The physical crack provides the actual trace that appears on that marked surface.

changed_reading.before: The crack is only damage to the sky.
changed_reading.after: The crack is simultaneously damage and a legible scar by which the transformed sky becomes recognizable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately continued sky does not fracture as an autonomous object: it receives, accepts, and fulfills what is due under lordship. Rupture becomes enacted responsiveness.

activation_trace.role: The overhead cover remains the grammatical actor whose breach is being reclassified.
The literal opening is the act now placed inside a relation of response.
Listening with acceptance makes the adjacent sky an attentive respondent rather than passive material.
Lordship and sovereignty supply the relation within which the response occurs.
Fixed obligation makes the response fitting and unavoidable, not accidental.

structural_cues: The feminine singular verbs continue across 84:1-2, keeping the sky as actor while the sequence moves from rupture to receptive fulfillment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies accepted hearing, lordship, and due obligation; I infer that the adjacent rupture realizes a received demand. A live alternative is that 84:2 describes the sky's stance after the break without assigning its cause.

changed_reading.before: The overhead cover fails through impersonal catastrophe.
changed_reading.after: The overhead cover opens as a fitting act of reception and fulfillment under its Lord.

context_deltas.mechanism: The upper boundary fissures while its lower counterpart is drawn out, ejects what it contains, and becomes vacant; both then share the same responsive formula. The sequence dismantles a bounded sky-earth container from both sides.

activation_trace.role: The upper covering supplies one boundary of the enclosure being unsealed.
Its fissure initiates loss of closure at the upper boundary.
The lower element explicitly opposed to the sky establishes a paired vertical system.
Lengthwise drawing removes the lower boundary's compact form and expands its reach.
Casting outward supplies the expulsion of what had been held inside the lower domain.
Vacancy completes the lower domain's emptying and confirms that containment has ended.
The repeated accepted hearing places the earth's transformation under the same responsive protocol as the sky's.
Repeated due obligation binds the paired transformations into one warranted sequence.

structural_cues: The إذا clauses at 84:1 and 84:3 pair sky and earth, and the wording of 84:2 is repeated at 84:5 after each body's transformation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed sky and earth, upper breach, lower extension, expulsion, vacancy, and repeated response; I infer a single enclosure being opened at both boundaries. They may instead be parallel signs with no shared container mechanics.

changed_reading.before: The sky's split is an isolated celestial disaster.
changed_reading.after: The sky's split is the upper half of a coordinated cosmic unsealing in which the lower world also loses compactness and contents.

context_deltas.mechanism: Once the overhead boundary opens, arduous human motion toward the Lord terminates in encounter. The breach can therefore function as a threshold on a trajectory, not merely an object of spectacle.

activation_trace.role: The overhead cover supplies the boundary that must cease sealing for a threshold reading to arise.
The opening converts that boundary into a possible passage point.
Repeated toil supplies sustained human motion rather than a static observer below the rupture.
Lordship identifies the governing endpoint toward which the motion is directed.
Two things coming face to face supplies arrival and encounter at the end of the trajectory.

structural_cues: The opening إذا clause precedes the cosmic sequence, while 84:6 introduces explicit movement إلى and closes it with meeting.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a breached upper boundary plus toil toward an encounter; I infer the breach as a threshold along that movement. The encounter may be purely relational or temporal, with no spatial passage through the sky implied.

changed_reading.before: The split sky is scenery around a later human reckoning.
changed_reading.after: The split sky opens the threshold horizon of a human trajectory whose endpoint is unavoidable encounter.

context_deltas.mechanism: Human striving leaves scratches, the next scenes materialize a written record, and a distinguishing mark guides knowledge. These cues intensify the baseline scar: the sky's fissure behaves as an exposed record of passage rather than mute damage.

activation_trace.role: The non-dominant image of an identifying mark makes the upper surface capable of carrying evidence.
The crack supplies the concrete line impressed on that evidentiary surface.
A scratch or bite-mark makes toil trace-producing and links effort to visible residue.
Ordered letters and the written object turn accumulated traces into a readable record.
A distinguishing sign that guides recognition makes the cosmic scar legible rather than merely visible.

structural_cues: Repeated k-d-h forms in 84:6 are followed by the first book scene in 84:7, while 84:23 returns to knowledge and what is held within.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies scratches, a written object, and a distinguishing sign; I transfer their record logic to the focus fissure. They may remain separate human-accounting images with no claim that the sky itself records anything.

changed_reading.before: The fissure is a visible omen left by catastrophe.
changed_reading.after: The fissure is an inscribed upper record, a trace through which passage and hidden history become readable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus division into corresponding sides is activated by two receptions of the same kind of book in opposed bodily orientations, followed by opposed relations to return. Cleavage becomes a spatial grammar for differentiated outcomes.

activation_trace.role: The raised visible whole supplies the field in which opposed orientations can become manifest.
Corresponding halves supply an ordered partition rather than arbitrary fragmentation.
The right hand and rightward side establish the first explicit bodily orientation of reception.
Turning back toward a destination gives the favorable side a completed return trajectory.
Placing something behind and out of view establishes the contrary orientation of reception.
The back as opposite of the belly makes that contrary orientation bodily concrete.
Denied return sharpens the contrast between the two sides into competing trajectories.

structural_cues: The parallel فأما and وأما scenes repeat receipt of a book while changing its side and the recipient's subsequent relation to return.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a focus split plus mirrored receptions, bodily sides, and opposed returns; I infer that the cosmic cleavage prefigures an ordering boundary. The two judgment scenes may classify people without spatially mapping onto the sky.

changed_reading.before: The sky divides without internal orientation.
changed_reading.after: Its division opens corresponding sides that can stage opposed positions of receipt and opposed trajectories of return.

context_deltas.mechanism: Twilight yields to night, night gathers what is dispersed, the moon reaches integrated fullness, and beings pass through superposed states. Within that sequence, splitting is a transition in a layered order, not necessarily the terminal cancellation of order.

activation_trace.role: The sky as upper cover locates the focus event in the same celestial field as the later phases.
Splitting supplies one radical change of state within the broader sequence.
Sunset redness supplies a visible boundary phase rather than a fixed celestial condition.
Night's darkness supplies the succeeding phase that overtakes the twilight boundary.
Gathering scattered things shows that cosmic change can collect and integrate as well as break apart.
Completion and evenness supply a phase of achieved coherence after gathering.
The moon and its sky-borne light make that coherent phase visibly celestial.
One thing superposed on another supplies the mechanics of traversing a layered order.
State after state supplies serial transformation as the sequence's explicit human correlate.

structural_cues: The oath sequence advances from twilight through gathering night and integrated moon to طبقا عن طبق; the إذا at 84:18 also echoes the focus ayah's temporal opening.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies successive celestial phases, gathering, completion, superposition, and state after state; I infer that the focus rupture is a crossing within serial order. It may instead remain a terminal event merely compared with ordinary cycles.

changed_reading.before: The split is a one-way end of celestial coherence.
changed_reading.after: The split is a threshold between layered states in an order where dispersal, gathering, and completion all remain live modes of change.

context_deltas.mechanism: A recited disclosure is refused, truth is covered and denied, yet what is held inwardly remains known. The opening of the sky's covering materializes the contrary process: cover and vessel can no longer keep contents or truth unavailable.

activation_trace.role: The overhead cover supplies the cosmic surface whose sealing function is reversed.
The fissure supplies forced opening against concealment.
Reading and recitation supply an offered mode of making meaning public.
Literal covering supplies the human counter-motion that tries to keep disclosure sealed.
Attributing falsehood supplies active rejection of what recitation exposes.
Disclosure to a knower prevents inward concealment from becoming actual unknowability.
A vessel holding something inside supplies the containment that the focus breach analogically defeats.

structural_cues: The sequence at 84:21-23 moves from public recitation, through refusal and covering, to knowledge of what is gathered inwardly.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recitation, covering, denial, knowing, and inward containment; I infer the split cover as cosmic anti-concealment. The human epistemic sequence may be thematic rather than a material explanation of the sky's rupture.

changed_reading.before: The sky opens only as a physical spectacle.
changed_reading.after: The upper cover's rupture stages forced legibility: coverings and containers cease to guarantee that what lies within can remain hidden.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah opens with continuity cut in the sky and closes with recompense explicitly exempted from a branch image of cutting and diminishing until extension stops. The focus rupture thus participates in a contrast between an order whose continuity ends and a grant whose continuity does not.

activation_trace.role: The continuous overhead surface supplies the created order whose integrity is interrupted.
Splitting supplies the opening cut against which uncut continuance can be heard.
Recompense identifies the enduring object whose continuity is at issue in the final phrase.
Exception and negation explicitly remove the following cutting image from the recompense.
Cutting and diminishing until extension ceases supplies the terminal continuity that the phrase negates.

structural_cues: The opening verse breaks an extended surface, while the final two words place negation directly before a term whose inventory includes severed extension.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a physical split and a final negation of cutting/diminishing; I infer a bookend contrast between cut created continuity and uncut recompense. The final adjective may foreground ungrudged gift rather than duration, leaving this contrast branch-dependent.

changed_reading.before: The sky's broken continuity is only a sign of ending.
changed_reading.after: Its cut continuity becomes the finite foil for a recompense whose extension is expressly not cut off.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because a physical split is activated through the root's distant throat-pouch and booming-speech image. It remains anchored in انشقت and gains contextual support from accepted hearing and later recitation; downstream prose should present it as a sound or communication analogy, not as a claim that the sky literally has a mouth.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The verbal root of انشقت includes an image of a throat membrane that opens into booming utterance, while السماء supplies the cosmic body bearing it.

activation_trace.role: The sky as overhead body supplies the large-scale bearer of the vocal analogy.
The throat pouch and booming speech turn the act of opening into a possible utterance event.
Accepted hearing gives the rupture an immediate auditory-response environment.
Recitation later supplies explicit voiced disclosure, strengthening the communicative analogy.

changed_reading.before: The sky undergoes a silent material fracture.
changed_reading.after: The fissure can be heard as cosmic utterance: opening itself communicates and calls for a listening response.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because أجر means recompense in 84:25 while its cited branch pictures setting a crooked break, and the verse never states that the sky is repaired. It remains anchored in the literal focus fracture and a final cluster of rectification and recompense; downstream prose should carry it only as a restorative material analogy that keeps irreversibility open.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The physical fissure in انشقت supplies an actual break whose possible afterlife is activated by the closing repair inventory.

activation_trace.role: The literal split supplies the fracture to which a later mending image can attach.
Rectitude opposed to corruption supplies a closing horizon in which damage need not be the only final state.
Setting a crooked break supplies the concrete restorative operation applied analogically to the focus fissure.

changed_reading.before: The split is necessarily irreversible destruction.
changed_reading.after: The split may be a fracture within a larger order that also admits re-setting and rectification, without asserting that repair occurs in the verse.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it depends on the non-dominant ن ش ق mapping, where the focus form activates entrapment in a loop rather than ordinary splitting. It remains anchored through that supplied mapping and is sharpened by the earth's later release; downstream prose should mark it as a cross-mapped structural image, not a lexical replacement for انشقت.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The mapped inventory of انشقت includes being caught in a snare or neck-loop, allowing the focus opening to register as failure of a binding structure.

activation_trace.role: The overhead cover supplies the structure whose binding integrity is in question.
Entrapment in a snare or neck-loop supplies the distant image of constraining bonds that can fail.
Release and letting go provide the directional motion from failed binding to cosmic discharge.

changed_reading.before: The sky's material simply cracks apart.
changed_reading.after: The crack can also image a restraining bond giving way, after which the paired cosmic order releases what it had held.

strongest_changes: 84:2 revises impersonal fracture into receptive fulfillment under lordship and fixed obligation.
84:3-5 turns the sky's opening into the upper half of a paired sky-earth unsealing.
84:16-19 reframes rupture as a crossing among gathered, completed, and superposed states rather than only terminal collapse.
84:21-23 makes the breached cover an anti-concealment mechanism in tension with covering, denial, and inward storage.
summary.what_was_special: The split root mappings kept several readings alive at once: the dominant breach became responsive, paired, transitional, and disclosive, while non-dominant mark and snare images made the same sky a readable scar and a released binding. The record and vocal readings were especially easy to lose under a conservative catastrophe-only synthesis.
remaining_uncertainties: The adjacency of accepted hearing and due obligation strongly changes agency, but it does not settle whether they cause the rupture or characterize the sky after it.
The phase sequence supports serial transformation but does not prove that the split sky later regathers or is restored.
The scar, vocal, repair, and released-binding readings depend on distant or non-dominant branches and must remain explicitly exploratory.
